user.title: Set up Geyser Pasteurization
user.description: Configure the temperature sensor and heater used to run scheduled Legionella disinfection cycles.

data_description.temperature_sensor: The sensor reporting the geyser's water temperature.
data_description.heater_entity: The switch, climate, or water_heater entity that engages the electric heating element.
data_description.target_temperature: Water must reach this temperature for disinfection to count.
data_description.required_duration_minutes: Minutes the temperature must stay at or above target, continuously.
data_description.rolling_window_days: If no valid cycle completes within this many days, a cycle becomes due.
data_description.max_runtime_minutes: Safety cutoff: the heater is disengaged if a cycle runs this long without completing.
data_description.allowed_start_time: Automatic cycles only start after this time of day. Leave blank to allow anytime.
data_description.allowed_end_time: Automatic cycles only start before this time of day. Leave blank to allow anytime.
data_description.strict_reset: If enabled, any drop below target resets the duration timer to zero instead of pausing it.

abort.already_configured: This temperature sensor and heater combination is already configured.

manual_pasteurization_trigger.description: Immediately starts a disinfection cycle, bypassing the allowed run window.
